summary: When Nora searched her memory and found things she is not allowed to repeat, she used to say she found nothing at all.
details: «I found something but may not repeat it» is now its own answer, separate from «nobody ever said anything about that» — previously the difference was explained in prose the model read second, after it had already acted on the wrong answer.
A search that matched nothing is also no longer counted as a successful lookup, so how often recall genuinely works is now visible rather than flattered.
limitations: Backfilled note: this shipped between V1 and V2 and was left out of V2's record, which covered only the GIF feature.
